llmention asks AI assistants the questions your buyers ask, using your own API keys. It reports how often each assistant mentions you next to your competitors, and which websites it cites.

Usage:
  llmention [command]

Examples:
llmention demo
llmention quick --brand Acme --category "invoicing for freelancers" --competitors "Globex,Initech" --engines openai,anthropic
llmention init
llmention run
llmention report
llmention report --trend

Get Started
  demo               Try llmention without API keys
  init               Write llmention.yaml for your product
  quick              Write llmention.yaml and run it in one step

Measure
  report             Show what the assistants said and how it changed
  run                Ask the assistants your prompts and save the answers

Manage
  discover           Suggest buyer questions to use as prompts
  history            List and export saved runs
  suites             List and check suites
  update             Check for a newer llmention release

Additional Commands:
  completion         Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help               Help about any command

Flags:
      --config string     Path to the config file
      --dry-run           Preview changes without performing them
  -h, --help              help for llmention
      --include-meta      Wrap machine output as {data, meta} (commands that expose request metadata)
      --jq string         Transform stable JSON output with a jq expression (commands with machine output)
      --json              Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi           Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color          Disable color in human output
      --no-pager          Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt         Never block on an interactive prompt
      --plain             Print unstyled, copy-safe text (commands with human output)
      --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
      --template string   Render stable JSON output through a Go text/template (commands with machine output)
  -v, --version           version for llmention

Use "llmention [command] --help" for more information about a command.
